# Pinned Studio sample contract controls

These Engine-only regression inputs are byte-for-byte functional artifacts from
the production Studio export of all three canonical sample projects at
`ae99f6d3924ba01429edbdb25712e7cfffb38583`. Studio owns the canonical projects;
these are pinned test inputs, not another authoring source. Export-only review,
assessment and local-session evidence files are intentionally excluded.

The insurance POST declares only 202, with no response content or response fields.
Its faithful response is empty, not an invented JSON schema. The two CRUD packs
retain their source status/body declarations. Tests block remote contract fetches
and require no sibling checkout or Studio installation. Source files and SHAs are
listed in `source-files.sha256`; refresh only from a recorded production export.

This is selected-transport preservation, not a new A1-A16 closeout, browser proof,
Suite L5 or current runtime claim for the dated September acceptance record.
